[[File:HL444HoverLoader-FFp42.png|thumb|right|250px|A [[HL-444 hover loader/Legends|HL-444 hover loader]]]]
'''Labor droids''', also known as '''heavy-duty droid''',<ref name="Escape">''[[Escape from the Death Star]]''</ref> and '''worker droids''',<ref name="GORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> were fifth-degree [[Droid/Legends|droids]] designed to perform menial labor duties. Many were assembled on [[Mechis III/Legends|Mechis III]].

They were usually designed to have limited intelligence, but some models were upgraded and able to handle complex tasks without needing to go back to their owners for instructions.<ref name="A&E">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''</ref>

The first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] had these droids working in the central loading bay. The droid was known to be "unstoppable."<ref name="Escape" />
{{Droid-stub}}
